lines.trans: Hello, show your documents for the car.
Please, here are all the necessary papers.
Tell me, what year is this Frontera?
This car is from the year 2008.
Yes, this is truly a very good car.
We bring in only the most reliable cars.
Where are you heading in it now?
We are hurrying to the town of Sineozersk now.
Listen, bro, let us through forward quickly.
We are in a very big hurry on business.
Alright, everything is in order with the documents.
Thank you very much for your quick help!
Go ahead, safe travels and have a good road!
Thanks, friend, we drove on further!

examples.trans: Here is a document from the prosecutor's office.

meanings.note: moving or capable of moving at high speed

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: direction: идти вперёд = to go forward
colloquial, like a preposition + genitive: лезть вперёд кого-то = to push in ahead of someone
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

meanings.note: after 2, 3, 4: года; after 5 and more: лет

examples.trans: I've been working here for four years.

examples.text: Это было давно, тридцать лет назад.
examples.trans: That was long ago, thirty years back.

meanings.note: in a list or a story
'два' with masculine/neuter nouns, 'две' with feminine; the noun goes into the genitive singular

examples.text: Настроение у меня действительно очень хорошее.
examples.trans: My mood really is very good.
This is indeed an important question.

meanings.note: много дел = a lot to do

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.

meanings.note: polite, or to several people; the first в is silent

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!
for movement; где is for location

examples.trans: Which car did you come in?

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.

meanings.en: to head, make one's way, be bound for

examples.trans: Where are you heading right now?

meanings.note: short form 'нужен / нужна / нужно / нужны' + dative: 'мне нужна работа' = I need a job

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

examples.trans: Shall we show this to Anikeev?

examples.trans: Now let's go through everything in order.

to let through, allow to pass

examples.trans: Here is a movie: A Thorny Path.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
